headline: EGYPT ECLIPSE (logo)
intro: A once-in-many-lifetimes journey to the longest remaining total solar eclipse of the century in Luxor, and the 8/8 Lion's Gate at the Pyramids of Giza.
notes: Personalised version: add ?for=Brand%20Name to the link to show "Prepared for Brand Name" under the description.

headline: Six minutes and twenty-three seconds of darkness over the Nile.
intro: On 2 August 2027 the Sun disappears over Luxor. The world will not see a longer totality on land for another eighty-seven years. We are gathering to meet this moment on purpose, with connection, awe, remembrance, discovery, and intentionality.
stats:
6:23 · Minutes of totality
87 · Years until a longer one on land
10 · Days, Aswan to Giza
footnote: Totality figures as published by Egypt Eclipse, egypt-eclipse.com

headline: Totality falls on the City of the Sun.
intro: Luxor, one of the oldest continuously inhabited places on Earth, was built over the ruins of Thebes, capital of Egypt during the New Kingdom. We view the eclipse from private land on the West Bank of the Nile, near the Colossi of Memnon, the Valley of the Queens, and the temple of Hatshepsut, Egypt's famous female pharaoh.

headline: Every path leads to the same moment.
intro: Artists, scientists, explorers, builders, and seekers travel the Nile together toward Luxor, where ancient civilizations aligned architecture and daily life with the movement of the sky.
body:
36 Hours · 1 to 2 Aug | The Eclipse Gathering | New Moon Opening Ceremony, Eclipse Day, and music into the evening on the West Bank.
7 Nights · 30 Jul to 6 Aug | The Nile River Cruise | Aswan to Luxor and back across two 5-star boats, with temples, talks, and ceremony.
5 to 7 Nights | The Hotel Stays | The historic Marsam and the Omda wellness retreat, both on Luxor's West Bank.
3 Nights · 6 to 9 Aug | The Giza Activation | Three days at the Pyramids, culminating in the 8/8 Lion's Gate celebration.

headline: Ten days between the ancient and the speculative.
intro: Not a traditional festival. Music, art, a speaker series, health and wellness, held at a human scale and led by the people in the room.
body:
On the River | Temple tours at dawn, talks while sailing the Nile, music in the evenings.
Heritage | Egyptologist-led visits to Karnak, Luxor Temple, Edfu, Kom Ombo, Philae, and Abu Simbel.
Ceremony & Wellness | Yoga and breathwork, shared meals, rest, and ceremony around totality.
Music on the Land | Local Egyptian musicians and international DJs after totality on the West Bank.

headline: A small, global circle of change-makers.
intro: Heart-centered artists, social impact entrepreneurs, world musicians, and conscious capitalists. Egypt is intentionally intimate, so partners meet the room face to face over ten days.
body: Quote: "70+ countries, and I have never traveled with people so amazingly present." (Sara A. · Scouting voyage, January 2026)
footnote: Iceland Eclipse 2026 audience, our most recent edition. Egypt figures reported to partners after the event.

eyebrow: Why It Matters to Your Brand
headline: Be part of the moment they will never forget.
intro: Brands don't need more impressions. They need meaning. Egypt Eclipse places your company inside a once-in-a-lifetime passage, with the people who will tell its story for years.
body:
I | Reach global travelers | A curated international audience that invests in rare, transformative travel.
II | Earn meaning | Associate your brand with awe, heritage, science, and wellbeing, not with noise.
III | Own the content | Stories and imagery from the Nile, Luxor's temples, and the Pyramids of Giza.
IV | Build loyalty | A community that follows the eclipse from chapter to chapter of the Trilogy.

headline: Iceland Eclipse proved the model.
intro: In August 2026, IMXP produced Iceland Eclipse on the Snæfellsnes Peninsula, a five-day gathering beneath totality, covered by The New York Times and CNN. Egypt carries that community to the Nile.

headline: Partner once, follow the whole arc.
intro: Egypt is the middle chapter of a story that began in Iceland and continues to Australasia. Partnerships spanning Egypt 2027 and Australasia 2028 are available on request.
body:
2026 | Iceland · Initiation | Where strangers became a circle beneath the northern sky.
2027 | Egypt · Activation | The middle chapter: one of the longest totalities of the century.
2028 | Australasia · Ascension | 22 July 2028, across Australia to New Zealand's South Island.
footnote: Where strangers became a circle beneath the northern sky.
notes: OPEN: confirm IMXP offers partnerships spanning Egypt 2027 and Australasia 2028.

headline: Partners deepen the experience, never interrupt it.
intro:
Egypt Eclipse works with its partners to create strategic, meaningful collaborations that place your brand inside the experience rather than beside it.

Through on-site activations, branding, media, and hosted moments, your company meets a globally engaged audience at one of the rarest events of their lives. Every level can be tailored to your objectives.
body:
Presence at the moment of totality, filmed and shared worldwide
Ten days of close contact with an influential community
Story-rich content from the Nile, Luxor, and Giza
A path into the Eclipse Trilogy through 2028
notes: OPEN: confirm "partners never interrupt the experience" as policy.
